plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says a couple of people, one of them under oath before the US Congress, have said that a man named Glenn Gaffney blocked a transfer of UFO material from Lockheed Martin, a large American defense company, to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. If true, it would mean private companies hold UFO material and someone stopped it changing hands.
